label: baseline
description: Gate baseline: work-package / skip-optional / robot + hot-resource probe, context_mode fresh. Recorded 2026-09-07 against workflows@95660422. Delivery is 1,421,070 characters over the same twelve-activity walk, a 3.8% rise on the 1,369,531 the previous recording measured at workflows@3695f3ab. This recording prices that rise rather than waiving it, and thirty-six corpus commits bought almost all of it. Resource delivery carries the largest share at 26,091 characters: the walk fetches ten more resources than it did (174 to 184, and the ledger 80 keys to 90), which is resource splitting for section-grain delivery rather than any one resource growing. Activity delivery rises 26,926 characters over an unchanged twelve calls, so the same deliveries each carry more. Of that, 1,159 characters are the exit_destinations block, which get_activity now sends so a worker can resolve its own routing; the remaining 25,767 is growth in the activity and technique bodies those twelve deliveries compose. The orchestrator bundle adds 3,061. Technique fetches fall 4,539 characters on one fewer call, the only saving in the set, from step techniques now arriving bundled. The rise is charged here because this is the adoption that crossed the threshold, not because the definitions it adopts are what drove it.
